mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.* FROM study_outline_drafts d WHERE d.user_id=#{userId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.confirmed_run_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM study_rooms r WHERE r.current_run_id=d.confirmed_run_id AND r.user_id=d.user_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ))
SELECT id,title,last_learning_at FROM study_rooms WHERE current_run_id=#{runId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_units WHERE run_id=#{runId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_completed_knowledge WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND step_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='FAILED'
SELECT p.updated_at,p.fragment_id,u.unit_spec_json FROM studyroom_learning_progress p JOIN studyroom_units u ON u.id=p.unit_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.run_id=#{runId}
SELECT * FROM study_outline_revisions WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT * FROM study_outline_drafts WHERE id=#{draftId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM study_outline_drafts WHERE id=#{draftId} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE study_outline_drafts SET display_title=#{title} WHERE id=#{draftId} AND user_id=#{userId}

UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET status='CANCELLED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,failure_code='COURSE_DELETED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET status='CANCELLED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,failure_code='COURSE_DELETED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE draft_id IN (SELECT id FROM study_outline_drafts WHERE source_room_id=#{roomId}) AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
UPDATE studyroom_runs SET status='CANCELLED',state_version=state_version+1 WHERE room_id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE study_outline_drafts SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,pending_job_id=NULL WHERE source_room_id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE study_rooms SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,current_run_id=NULL,current_step_id=NULL WHERE id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId}
